summary: Hardware input setup: logs an entry message when the session type is not 5 and debug logging is enabled, creates a DirectInput8 interface, then on success builds and re-initializes a set of input sub-device slots in the ppvOut array (window surface, two device slots each initialized, destroyed and re-initialized). Returns the final sub-device global-state initializer result on success, or the DirectInput8Create HRESULT on failure.

local_names.ppvOut: output object array receiving the DirectInput8 interface and sub-device slots

operations.description: If dword_7C569C != 5 (session type is not 5) and StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_13, 5225) returns true, debug logging is enabled for this path.
Call DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aEnteredHwinput_0) to log the input-setup entry message.
Call DirectInput8Create(hinst, 0x800, &riidltf, ppvOut, 0) to create the DirectInput8 interface and store it into ppvOut.
Proceed with sub-device setup only when result (the DirectInput8Create HRESULT) is 0.
Call D3DWindowSurfaceCreation(ppvOut + 1, hWnd, byte_5EC4A4, 2) to create a D3D window surface for the first input sub-device.
Call DirectXDeviceInitialization(ppvOut + 866, hWnd, byte_5EC4A4) to initialize sub-device slot 866.
Call DirectXDeviceInitialization(ppvOut + 1121, hWnd, byte_5EC4A4) to initialize sub-device slot 1121.
Call CollisionObjectDestructor(ppvOut + 1121) to tear down sub-device slot 1121.
Call CollisionObjectDestructor(ppvOut + 866) to tear down sub-device slot 866.
Call DirectXDeviceInitialization(ppvOut + 866, hWnd, byte_5EC4A4) to re-initialize sub-device slot 866.
Call DirectXDeviceInitialization(ppvOut + 1121, hWnd, byte_5EC4A4) to re-initialize sub-device slot 1121.

On success, return the result of the final call that initializes global state from enum values over ppvOut (named GlobalStateInitializerWithEnumValues in the raw source; not present in the packet callee records).
On DirectInput8Create failure, return result (the nonzero HRESULT).

unresolved: The final success-path call (GlobalStateInitializerWithEnumValues per raw source) has no address in the packet callee records; its target cannot be pinned from this packet alone.
Which physical input device each element slot (866, 1121) corresponds to is unknown; the slots are identified by raw-source element indices only.
The 0x800 argument to DirectInput8Create and the role of byte_5EC4A4 (window surface configuration) are unverified from packet evidence.
Legacy ABI name HWInput_Setup (abi:lead) is retained as a lead only; the owning object type remains unknown.
